entry.title: Canucks Project Leevi Merilainen vs. Wild as Quinn Hughes Returns, Oct. 25, 2026
entry.summary: Leevi Merilainen is projected to start for Vancouver against Minnesota on Sunday after Kevin Lankinen played Thursday. Calvin Pickard is confirmed for the Wild.

entry.title: Islanders Expect Ilya Sorokin vs. Jake Oettinger in Dallas, Oct. 25, 2026
entry.summary: The Islanders' own game preview says Ilya Sorokin is expected to start at Dallas on Sunday, against an expected Jake Oettinger. Neither start had been officially confirmed when we published.

entry.title: Jets Goalie for Heritage Classic: Skinner or Stevenson After Hellebuyck Trade; Canadiens Starter Not Announced
entry.summary: Winnipeg plays its first game since trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson as its two NHL goalies. Neither the Jets nor the Canadiens had confirmed a Heritage Classic starter in the sources we checked.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Monday, Oct. 26, 2026: Kings-Rangers, Leafs-Flames, Red Wings-Oilers
entry.summary: Monday's three-game NHL slate has no confirmed starters yet. Here is who started each team's last game, from official NHL box scores, so you know what to watch for.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Tonight (Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026): Schmid, Knight and Pickard Confirmed; Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner Expected
entry.summary: Five NHL games Sunday. Akira Schmid and Spencer Knight started in Chicago, and Calvin Pickard is confirmed for Minnesota. Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner, Wedgewood, Annunen and Merilainen are expected.

entry.title: Panthers Confirm Akira Schmid in Goal at Blackhawks Tonight; Blackhawks Expected to Turn to Soderblom
entry.summary: Florida confirms Akira Schmid starts Sunday at Chicago with Jacob Markstrom injured. NHL.com projects Arvid Soderblom for Chicago after Spencer Knight's five straight starts.

entry.title: Predators Close Back-to-Back vs. Avalanche After Saros' 34-Save Night in Pittsburgh
entry.summary: Nashville hosts Colorado on the second night of a back-to-back after Juuse Saros played Saturday in Pittsburgh, and the team is skipping its morning skate. Neither club has confirmed a starter.

entry.title: Wild Confirm Calvin Pickard Starts at Canucks Tonight on Back-to-Back
entry.summary: Minnesota coach John Hynes split the weekend back-to-back: Jesper Wallstedt started Saturday at Seattle and Calvin Pickard starts Sunday in Vancouver. The Canucks have not confirmed their goalie.
